# Terms

Every word the library app uses, with its meaning. Only what the app does today is listed.

## Member

| Term             | Definition                                                          |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Member           | A person registered with the library who can borrow.                |
| Borrow limit     | Maximum number of open loans for a member. Set by staff; default 5. |
| Within the limit | Open loans never exceed the member's borrow limit.                  |

## Title

| Term  | Definition                                                                        |
| ----- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Title | A work in the catalog: a book, a board game, a tool model. Has one or more items. |

## Item

| Term              | Definition                                                     |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Item              | One physical copy of a title; the thing that is actually lent. |
| One loan per item | An item is on at most one open loan.                           |

## Loan

| Term                 | Definition                                                                         |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Loan                 | An item lent to a member, from checkout until return.                              |
| Due date             | When the item must be back: checkout plus the loan period, moved by renewals.      |
| Renewals             | How many times the loan was renewed. A fact the system counts.                     |
| Overdue              | The loan is open and the due date has passed.                                      |
| Loan period          | 21 days from checkout.                                                             |
| Renewal rule         | Up to 2 renewals per loan, each adds 14 days to the current due date.              |
| No renewal when held | A loan cannot be renewed while someone waits for the title.                        |
| Check out            | Open a loan for an item and a member. Refused with a reason if a rule would break. |
| Return               | Close the loan and record the item's condition.                                    |
| Renew                | Move the due date by the renewal rule. Refused while someone waits for the title.  |

## Hold

| Term           | Definition                                                         |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Hold           | A member's place in the queue for a title whose items are all out. |
| Queue position | The hold's place in the title's queue, by placement time.          |
| Place hold     | Join the title's queue. Only when no item is available.            |

## Screens

| Term     | Definition                                                                                 |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| My loans | A member's open loans and holds: due dates, overdue marks, renew buttons, queue positions. |
